system.description:
You spin around with your weapon, a dance-like attack that bewilders enemies. Make a melee Taijutsu attack, comparing the result against the AC of all creatures within your weapons range. On a hit, you deal your weapon damage+1d6. If you have Fury, you can spend it to increase this jutsu’s critical threat range by +2.

Chain 1: Affected creatures cannot make an opportunity attack against you, until the beginning of their next turn. At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
